source_provenance.module_symvers_provenance: Hash-verified against the existing NX809J target-kernel attestation; this file is not published as a release asset.

setup_command:
set -eu
/work/bindgen/bin/bindgen --version | grep -Fx 'bindgen 0.69.5'
test "$(sha256sum /work/bindgen/bin/bindgen | awk '{print $1}')" = '548b0056945e282fdb35da366350e68feb9ff28b6582398db171f12229089706'
git clone --local --no-hardlinks /seed/kernel /work/src/kernel
cd /work/src/kernel
git remote set-url origin 'https://github.com/Coding-BR/android_kernel_nubia_sm8850_qwjujube.git'
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '3356b35306d35d5a480e3b63df1a9f065b5d9f55'
mkdir -p target_build_inputs
cp "/repo/kernel_development/config/nx809j_target_kernel_20260711.config" "target_build_inputs/nx809j_target_kernel_20260711.config"
cp "/repo/kernel_development/config/nx809j_target_Module.symvers" target_build_inputs/Module.symvers
cp "/repo/kernel_development/config/nx809j_target_localversion" "kernel_platform/common/localversion.nx809j-target"
S=/work/src/kernel/kernel_platform/common
O=/work/src/kernel/.codex-kbuild/identity
mkdir -p "$O"
cp "target_build_inputs/nx809j_target_kernel_20260711.config" "$O/.config"
cp target_build_inputs/Module.symvers "$O/Module.symvers"
export PATH=/work/bindgen/bin:/work/toolchains/clang-r536225/bin:/work/toolchains/rust-1.82.0/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export BINDGEN=/work/bindgen/bin/bindgen
export KBUILD_BUILD_TIMESTAMP='2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' KBUILD_BUILD_USER=codex KBUILD_BUILD_HOST=reproducible
make -s -C "$S" O="$O" ARCH=arm64 LLVM=1 LLVM_IAS=1 BINDGEN="$BINDGEN" modules_prepare
config_sha=$(sha256sum "$O/.config" | awk '{print $1}')
symvers_sha=$(sha256sum "$O/Module.symvers" | awk '{print $1}')
localversion_sha=$(sha256sum "$S/localversion.nx809j-target" | awk '{print $1}')
kernel_release=$(make -s -C "$S" O="$O" ARCH=arm64 LLVM=1 LLVM_IAS=1 kernelrelease)
test "$config_sha" = 'b3ca00186d0849f409e760297023cd3b198202656f216f5726704c05fa944288'
test "$symvers_sha" = '28083216e6811ec80cee75c23da0c33168eb1206e008cd2cc469fe4592f0ac83'
test "$localversion_sha" = 'e6e709d1774e4e549dedc3e27619be24709f510e64493c1744c11bd045503475'
test "$kernel_release" = '6.12.23-android16-5-gf1bdb13583da-ab13761046-4k'
printf '%s\n' \
  "source_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
  "source_repository=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)" \
  "kernel_release=$kernel_release" \
  "config_sha256=$config_sha" \
  "module_symvers_sha256=$symvers_sha" \
  "localversion_sha256=$localversion_sha" \
  "bindgen_version=$(/work/bindgen/bin/bindgen --version)" \
  "bindgen_sha256=$(sha256sum /work/bindgen/bin/bindgen | awk '{print $1}')"
